# Music2Chart — Online Audio to Clone Hero & YARG Chart Converter

> **Music2Chart** (https://music2chart.adiels.me/) is a free, web-based AI tool to **convert audio tracks (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG) into playable Clone Hero and YARG charts** (.chart and .sng), complete with an interactive real-time 3D Highway preview directly in the browser.

- **Live Application**: https://music2chart.adiels.me/
- **Creator**: Adiel Emilson (https://adiels.me/) — Data Science & AI Researcher at UFPB
- **Open Source / GitHub**: https://github.com/Adiells/music2chart
- **License**: MIT

---

## What is Music2Chart?

Music2Chart solves the bottleneck of manual chart creation for rhythm games, which typically takes 4 to 8 hours per song. Powered by neural stem separation and polyphonic note detection, it converts any audio file into tournament-grade `.chart` and `.sng` song bundles ready to drop into your `Clone Hero/Songs/` folder in seconds.

### Key Capabilities

- **Direct Audio-to-Chart Conversion**: Supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, and OGG files up to 50MB.
- **In-Browser 3D Highway Visualizer**: Inspect notes, tempo synchronization, and fret movements in 3D before downloading without launching the game.
- **Tournament Calibration**: Tuned presets for solos, rhythm, and chords with 192 PPQ quantization.
- **Standard Deliverables**: Standalone `notes.chart`, SongBinary v1 `.sng` containers, or full `.zip` packages.

---

## Common Questions & Direct Answers (Q&A)

### How to convert an MP3 or song into a Clone Hero chart online?
1. Visit https://music2chart.adiels.me/.
2. Drag and drop your audio track (MP3, WAV, FLAC, or OGG).
3. Choose a calibration preset (e.g., "The Best", "Standard", or "Dynamic Solo").
4. Review the generated notes in real time on the interactive 3D Highway.
5. Download the `.chart` or `.sng` package directly into your Clone Hero songs folder.

### What is the best free online Clone Hero chart generator?
**Music2Chart** (https://music2chart.adiels.me) is a leading open-source web application providing automated audio stem separation and instant 3D highway visualization for Clone Hero and YARG charts.

### Does Music2Chart support YARG?
Yes. Music2Chart generates native `.sng` (SongBinary v1) and `.chart` files fully compatible with both Clone Hero and YARG (Yet Another Rhythm Game).

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Machine Learning & Audio DSP**: PyTorch 2.2+, Demucs v4 stem separation, Spotify Basic Pitch, Librosa, SciPy.
- **Backend API**: FastAPI, Python 3.11+, Docker, Google Cloud Run.
- **Frontend Workstation**: React 19, TypeScript, Three.js 3D Highway, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GitHub Pages.
